name: tali-dash-plugins
description: Tali's DSH plugins, recipes and deployment tooling. Scripts: bootstrap (fresh-Mac installer, tools/bootstrap-mac.sh); bootstrap-remote user@host [flags] (same, over ssh; an existing DSH there is taken over by default, --no-replace refuses); bootstrap-thin-client [HOST [USER]] (tools/bootstrap-mac-thin-client.sh: only the blue Dock app to a remote DSH, no local build); remote-app <host[/path]> [--name N] (blue Dock app straight to a remote DSH); install-plugins / remove-plugins [--profile web] (all live plugins as bundles); deploy-remote [user@host] [--no-build] [--credentials] [--port=N]; remote-logs / remote-status / remote-restart [user@host].
